data.title: Street Food Market and Food Trucks
data.summary: 48 stylized street food market models: food trucks, vans and trailers with rolling wheels and lifting serving hatches, gazebo, trestle, grill, wok and bar stalls, ported floor tiles, counters, queue rail and festoon lighting, seating, service kit and the food left on the tables.
data.description: Everything needed to build a street food market and park the trucks that trade at it. The fleet is a step front food truck with a cab, a box body, a 2.1 m serving hatch over a timber counter and an awning above it, the same truck shipped with the hatch already open and in two more liveries, a coffee van, an ice cream van with a roof cone, a towed pizza trailer with an oven flue, an insulated chiller trailer with a hinged tail door and a three wheeled food tuk tuk. The stalls are a 3 m pop up gazebo with a canopy and a counter, the same gazebo as a bare frame to dress, a trestle stall with an awning in two colours, a grill station with an extractor hood, a wok and crepe station, a bar stall with taps, and the signage around them: menu boards, a chalkboard A frame, pitch number signs and a market parasol. Four things tile on real connector ports: 4 m paved and cobbled floor tiles, 2 m stall counter modules, 2 m queue rail bays and 6 m festoon lighting bays, and the starter scene is assembled from all four. Seating is picnic benches, high tables, stools and pallet units; the service kit is bins, a three stream recycling station, hand wash points, a generator, a gas bottle cage, a water butt, a fire point, cool boxes and crate stacks. The counters are dressed with trays of burger and chips, a pizza on a board, coffee cups, bottle crates, sauces, a napkin caddy, a produce crate, a cake stand under a dome and a till. Clips are rigid node transforms only: wheels roll, serving hatches lift, the chiller door swings, bin, cool box and cake dome lids open and close, the till drawer runs out and the hood fan spins. Canopies, awnings, valances, cloths, the festoon cord and its bulbs, the tuk tuk roof and the chalkboard hinge are modelled solid and stated static, because fabric and folding linkages need a joint per element that a rigid node cannot give; there is no steam, flame, smoke or crowd. Stall names, liveries and menu boards are invented and copy no real trader, chain or brand. Original AI-generated CC0 geometry, prepared for human review. No physics, gameplay, colliders, navigation or embedded lights.

starterScene.title: Street Food Market Yard at Trading Hours (Street Food Market and Food Trucks)
starterScene.summary: A 24 x 28 m closed street trading as a street food market, laid in one continuous paved surface with a cobbled strip under the trucks. Seven stalls run down the west side, a gazebo, two trestles, a grill, a wok and crepe station and a bar, with a dressed bare frame on a run...
starterScene.description: A 24 x 28 m closed street trading as a street food market, laid in one continuous paved surface with a cobbled strip under the trucks. Seven stalls run down the west side, a gazebo, two trestles, a grill, a wok and crepe station and a bar, with a dressed bare frame on a run of counter modules at the top and a queue rail at the grill. Three food trucks, a coffee van, an ice cream van, a chiller trailer, a pizza trailer and a tuk tuk stand down the east side and across the back with their serving hatches open. Two rows of festoon lighting cross the yard on their own poles, and picnic benches, high tables, stools and pallet seating fill the middle with trays, pizza, coffee and drinks left on them. Bins, recycling, hand wash points, a generator, gas and water stand at the ends.

assets.description: A 24 x 28 m closed street trading as a street food market, laid in one continuous paved surface with a cobbled strip under the trucks. Seven stalls run down the west side, a gazebo, two trestles, a grill, a wok and crepe station and a bar, with a dressed bare frame on a run of counter modules at the top and a queue rail at the grill. Three food trucks, a coffee van, an ice cream van, a chiller trailer, a pizza trailer and a tuk tuk stand down the east side and across the back with their serving hatches open. Two rows of festoon lighting cross the yard on their own poles, and picnic benches, high tables, stools and pallet seating fill the middle with trays, pizza, coffee and drinks left on them. Bins, recycling, hand wash points, a generator, gas and water stand at the ends.
